name: One More Day
source:
South Pole snow desert. After an accident in the laboratory, only two men survive. But for how long?

[From [url=https://abra-geroni.itch.io/one-more-day]Itch.io[/url]]

南极，一片冰雪荒漠。实验室出了事故，只有两个男人活下来。可他们还能活多久？
